courses.title: System Design in Cloud
courses.why: A very short course (Priyanka Vergadia) that designs three systems end to end on Google Cloud: video streaming, maps and ride sharing. Good for the shape of a design answer.

courses.title: Software Architecture: Patterns for Developers
courses.why: Recent and practical (Peter Morlion): layered, event-driven, microservice and other patterns, how to choose between them and how to recognise them in an existing system.

portals.name: The System Design Primer (GitHub)
portals.what: The classic free guide: building blocks, trade-offs and worked interview questions with solutions.

portals.name: Hello Interview: system design in a hurry
portals.what: A free, interview-focused delivery framework and the core concepts to cover, with worked problem breakdowns elsewhere on the site.

portals.name: ByteByteGo system design guides
portals.what: Short illustrated explainers of real-world architectures and building blocks (caching, queues, databases, API design).

portals.name: roadmap.sh System Design roadmap
portals.what: A topic map from performance and scalability basics to patterns; use it to find gaps.

portals.name: GeeksforGeeks: top system design interview questions
portals.what: Common design prompts (URL shortener, chat, news feed, rate limiter…) to practise out loud against a clock.

assessments.name: Software Engineer (role certification)
assessments.format: Timed online test, about 1 hour 15 minutes, 3 questions covering problem solving, SQL and REST APIs
assessments.credential: HackerRank role certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: There is no general system design certification; this role certificate shows the breadth (algorithms, data, APIs) a design interviewer expects you to build on.

assessments.name: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
assessments.format: 130-minute exam, 65 multiple-choice and multiple-response questions, test centre or online proctored
assessments.credential: AWS certification and Credly badge, valid for 3 years
assessments.why: The most widely recognised architecture certification; its scenarios (availability, scaling, storage and database choices, cost) are system design questions with AWS names.

assessments.name: Google Cloud Professional Cloud Developer
assessments.format: 2-hour proctored exam, 50–60 multiple-choice and multiple-select questions
assessments.credential: Google Cloud professional certification and digital badge
assessments.why: If your target roles run on Google Cloud: it tests designing scalable, reliable cloud-native applications, which overlaps heavily with design interviews.
